components.name: Primary action
components.css: .ds-button-primary{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.4;font-weight:600;min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:11px 16px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;background:var(--beacon-gold, #FFBF00);color:var(--ink, #1E253B);border:1px solid var(--ink, #1E253B);}.ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--primary-hover, #EDB000);}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink, #1E253B);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-button-primary:disabled{background:#e8e8e5;color:#60605a;border-color:#a4a49d;cursor:not-allowed;}

components.name: Secondary action
components.css: .ds-button-secondary{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.4;font-weight:600;min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:11px 16px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;background:var(--secondary-surface, #DCE7F7);color:var(--brand-navy, #173B75);border:1px solid var(--brand-navy, #173B75);}.ds-button-secondary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--secondary-hover, #CBDCF2);}.ds-button-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink, #1E253B);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-button-secondary:active:not(:disabled){background:var(--secondary-active, #B8CDE9);}.ds-button-secondary:disabled{background:#e8e8e5;color:#60605a;border-color:#a4a49d;cursor:not-allowed;}

components.name: Recapture disclosure
components.description: Framed native disclosure demonstrating the secondary family and expanded indicator.
components.html:
Preview recapture

Photograph the complete date panel. Synthetic preview only.
components.css: .ds-recapture{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;color:var(--ink, #1E253B);}.ds-recapture summary{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.4;font-weight:600;min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:11px 16px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;justify-content:space-between;background:var(--secondary-surface, #DCE7F7);color:var(--brand-navy, #173B75);border:1px solid var(--brand-navy, #173B75);}.ds-recapture summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}.ds-recapture summary:hover,.ds-recapture[open] summary{background:var(--secondary-hover, #CBDCF2);}.ds-recapture summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink, #1E253B);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-recapture[open] svg{transform:rotate(180deg);}.ds-recapture p{font-size:.8125rem;}

components.name: Extracted field
components.description: Read-only evidence is explained before the field.
components.html: Illustrative extracted field; not editable in this preview.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;font: .8125rem/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;color:var(--ink, #1E253B);}.ds-field input{font:inherit;padding:9px;border:1px dashed var(--control, #748096);border-radius:6px;background:var(--canvas, #F7F8FA);color:var(--muted, #535D71);}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink, #1E253B);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-help{font:.75rem/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;color:var(--muted, #535D71);}

components.name: Queue filter
components.description: Native select with an inset chevron and reserved label padding.
components.css: .ds-filter{font:.875rem/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;color:var(--ink, #1E253B);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;}.ds-select{display:inline-grid;position:relative;}.ds-select select{appearance:none;font:inherit;min-height:44px;padding:8px 44px 8px 12px;background:var(--surface, #FFFFFF);color:var(--ink, #1E253B);border:1px solid var(--control, #748096);border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;}.ds-select svg{position:absolute;right:14px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);pointer-events:none;}.ds-select select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink, #1E253B);outline-offset:4px;}@media(forced-colors:active){.ds-select select{appearance:auto;padding-right:12px;}.ds-select svg{display:none;}}

components.name: Workspace navigation
components.description: Current destination has fill, underline and semantic state.
components.html: Check a productRetail queueCapture guidance
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;font:.9rem/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;}.ds-nav a{min-height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:10px 16px;color:var(--ink, #1E253B);border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;font-weight:550;text-decoration:none;}.ds-nav a:hover{background:var(--canvas, #F7F8FA);}.ds-nav a[aria-current]{background:var(--ink, #1E253B);border-color:var(--ink, #1E253B);color:var(--surface, #FFFFFF);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.3em;}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink, #1E253B);outline-offset:4px;}

components.description: Mint marks a completed simulated step, not safety or clearance.

components.name: Evidence field selector
components.description: A visible control for inspecting paired evidence.
components.css: .ds-field-pick{font:.8125rem/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-weight:600;min-height:44px;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid var(--brand-navy, #173B75);border-radius:6px;background:var(--secondary-surface, #DCE7F7);color:var(--brand-navy, #173B75);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;}.ds-field-pick:hover{background:var(--secondary-hover, #CBDCF2);}.ds-field-pick:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink, #1E253B);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-field-pick[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--selected, #FFF3ED);color:var(--accent, #B93819);border-color:var(--accent, #B93819);text-decoration:underline;}

narrative.overview:
The interface is calm, direct and visibly actionable. Rich blue identity and a
small number of vivid gold actions sit on light, carefully separated surfaces.
Color helps people locate evidence, distinguish a proposal from a completed step,
and recognize their next action. Clear language and visible boundaries carry the
same meaning when color is unavailable.

This is the owner-approved visual system, extracted from the refined prototype
at `b145ac6f25ef55c633fb61723694da54be811614`. See the
[U02 approval record](docs/evidence/M1-visual-approval.md) and
[source/capture manifest](docs/ui/usability/manifest.json). The original directions
and rejected intermediate palettes remain historical. This document records
visual authority; it does not certify runtime behavior or accessibility compliance.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence and decisions have distinct, readable places.
Primary and secondary controls look actionable before interaction.
Color roles remain stable across desktop, phone and every workflow state.
Persistent navigation, visible focus and explicit recovery support task continuity.

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Every consequential state has a text label and a structural cue; color alone never conveys selection, availability or outcome.

dos: Do preserve the approved color roles across every route and state.
Do align headings and values by their shared column containers.
Do show a visible boundary and clear label for an action before hover.
Do pair color with text, shape, checked state or another structural cue.
Do inspect default, expanded, error, empty, disabled and confirmed states on desktop and phone.
donts: Don't use mint to imply safety, clearance or permission to sell.
Don't turn static stage labels into apparent links.
Don't make reset, recapture or evidence inspection look like inert text.
Don't hide overflow by clipping required evidence or focus indicators.
Don't treat prototype tests or visual approval as runtime or source-truth acceptance.
